description: Merge a branch/changeset/label into the current workspace branch. Refused while tracked pending changes exist or when the merge has conflicts (resolve those in the UVCS client); the merge result stays pending until a checkin. Requires prepare/confirm. Confirms and executes a prepared operation. Call only after the user has reviewed the prepared payload and explicitly approved this exact operation.

confirmPhrase.description: Must be exactly: confirm uvcs merge

name: uvcs_merge_confirm
